name: list_roblox_studios
description: Lists the connected Roblox Studio instances so a call can be directed at one. Several instances are commonly open at once, so every tool call must include a `studio_id` identifying the target instance — call this tool first to obtain the ids. Each result has an `id` and a human-readable `name` (including its place id or file name); use the `name` to choose the intended instance, confirming with the user before modifying their game.
